plan.title: Create Single-Stage RFP from Open Material PR

steps.note: Assert that the RFP questionnaire screen does not expose a pricing column.
Provide the mandatory event title using the product's generated title behavior.
Add the two vendors named in the case.
Publish the configured PR-based RFP event.
Assert that publication reached a real event project page.
Open the published event's Settings menu to inspect the PR-specific action restriction.
Assert that Recreate Order is greyed out on the published event.
Verify that the In Progress PR list contains at least one row, while noting that the catalog cannot correlate it to the selected PR and event number.
